Jvālāmukhī
(‘[goddess whose] face is tongues of fire’)
------------------------------------------
This is one of the several शक्तिपीठस् (See under TANTRAS). This place of पिल्ग्रिमगे is about 35 kms. (22 miles) from the Kangra town in Himachal Pradesh. The wonderful temple here has no idol. Natural jets of gas—about ten in number—come out of the rock where the temple has been built. When set on fire, these jets are revered as the mukha (or face or) mouth of the goddess.
The tongue of देवी or शक्ति (Dākṣāyaṇī) is said to have fallen here.
This goddess is also known as Siddhidā and अम्बिका. The corresponding aspect of शिव is Unmatta (‘the Mad-one’).
